articles.title: Morning Mail: One Nation sleepovers at Rinehart’s revealed, Japan trips getting more expensive, and more AI alarm
articles.description: Want to get this in your inbox every weekday? Sign up for the Morning Mail here , and finish your day with our Politics, really newsletter . Good morning. The four-part series follows senior correspondent Sarah Martin as she uncovers the inner workings of Pauline Hanson’s One Nation – a party that has imported the modus operandi of the global populist right, including Trump-style attacks on the media. Elsewhere there’s speculation over the intended target of a Russian drone strike near the Ukraine-Poland border. articles.title: JH Gwangan Mixed-use building / U.GA Architects
articles.description: Situated in Mangmi-dong, Busan , the site occupies a sharp, acute-angled corner where a dynamic, high-traffic arterial road heading towards Haeundae collides with the quaint charm of an old residential alleyway and antique shops. While this prominent location offers ideal commercial visibility, it simultaneously imposes a defensive burden on the residential volumes above: shielding the inhabitants from relentless urban noise and intrusive gazes. In response, the architecture does not retreat into a closed, defensive fortress; rather, it manifests as a "permeable filter" that embraces the cityscape and its intense sunlight while safely cradling its residents.
